name: BotIQ ITSM Create Incident Agent
description: A Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent that authenticates users via SSO and creates ITSM incidents in the BotIQ ITSM system. Supports account selection, asset-based incident creation, and configurable priority and support tier.
